title: Crab holding a heart
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- crab body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='60' rx='24' ry='16' fill='#ff5533'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='57' rx='16' ry='10' fill='#ff7755'/>
  <!-- crab shell texture -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='55' r='2' fill='#ffaa88'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='2' fill='#ffaa88'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='55' r='2' fill='#ffaa88'/>

  <line x1='40' y1='48' x2='34' y2='38' stroke='#ff5533' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='60' y1='48' x2='66' y2='38' stroke='#ff5533' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='34' cy='36' r='5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='36' r='5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='34' cy='36' r='2.5' fill='#222244'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='36' r='2.5' fill='#222244'/>
  <circle cx='35' cy='35' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='35' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>

  <path d='M44 62 Q50 68 56 62' fill='none' stroke='#aa2211' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <path d='M26 56 Q16 46 12 50 Q8 54 14 58 Q18 60 22 58' fill='#ff4422' stroke='#ff8866' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <path d='M14 58 Q10 62 16 64 Q20 62 22 58' fill='#ff4422' stroke='#ff8866' stroke-width='1.5'/>

  <path d='M74 56 Q82 48 86 52 Q90 56 86 60 Q82 62 78 59' fill='#ff4422' stroke='#ff8866' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <path d='M86 60 Q90 64 84 66 Q80 64 78 59' fill='#ff4422' stroke='#ff8866' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- little legs -->
  <path d='M34 70 L28 78 L30 78' fill='none' stroke='#ff5533' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <path d='M42 73 L38 82 L40 82' fill='none' stroke='#ff5533' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <path d='M58 73 L62 82 L60 82' fill='none' stroke='#ff5533' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <path d='M66 70 L72 78 L70 78' fill='none' stroke='#ff5533' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <!-- heart in right claw -->
  <path d='M83 60 C83 54 74 52 74 60 C74 68 83 73 83 73 C83 73 92 68 92 60 C92 52 83 54 83 60 Z' fill='#ff2266'/>
  <!-- heart shine -->
  <ellipse cx='79' cy='58' rx='2' ry='1.5' fill='#ff88aa' transform='rotate(-30 79 58)'/>
</svg>
